mike_r: Starting bring-up for scout-4b-int4 on staging. Need a targeted audit slab (~720 samples) focused on hallucinations, token-splitting, and code-snippet fidelity. Can someone own carve+label?
eva: I can assemble the slab. Plan: 520 NL (mix long/short), 120 multi-turn, 80 code. Will run paraphrase-graph dedupe and a token-alignment pass to catch tokenizer drift.
gita: For code, include execable snippets and small integration prompts (dockerfile snippets, SQL). Tag languages and add a compile/check flag.
liz: Label ops can run a 48h microburst with 5 labelers. Need a concise rubric + quick QA steps. Suggest micro-golden seeds (~40) seeded across batches.
sanjay: Infra note: quant hysteresis toggle is enabled in staging; keep fp16 fallback when 95p latency >1.0s. Also add very-short prefix (<8 tokens) and very-long (>2048) to probe KV differences.
label-bot: label-bot: job created scout_audit_1805001234; est throughput 460/hr.
eva: Candidate manifest uploaded to s3://redwood-internal/curation/scout_audit_1805001234/candidates.csv (includes provenance, token_count, seed_tag). Running dedupe now (graph threshold 0.65).
liz: Draft instruction bullets:
- factuality: yes|no|partial
- error_type: fabrication|contradiction|omission|tokenization|code-fail
- severity: low|med|high
- reproduce_steps: text
- micro_golden_hit: yes|no
We'll add 6 examples in the doc.
mike_r: After labels reach 60% run eval harness: hallucination precision/recall, token-split mismatch rate, code-exec pass rate. Diff vs scout-v1-fp16 and paste results. Also export top-10 failure cases.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scout-4b-int4 -> staging rollout succeeded (2/2 hosts). Observability hooks live.
sanjay: Perf note: int4 throughput +2.1x. 95p latency on >1024 ctx up ~13%. Sampling variance higher on code prompts at low temp, capturing logs for triage.
label-bot: label-bot: first tranche (180) assigned; ETA ~4.5h.
mike_r: Thanks. Reconvene at 60% labeled to triage failures. :thumbsup:
